name: AcPictureCaptionArrangement
description: Used with the PictureCaptionArrangement property to determine how a button's caption is arranged in relation to its picture.

constants.name: acGeneral
constants.description: The caption uses the General alignment setting.

constants.name: acTop
constants.description: The caption appears above the picture.

constants.name: acBottom
constants.description: The caption appears below the picture.

constants.name: acLeft
constants.description: The caption appears to the left of the picture.

constants.name: acRight
constants.description: The caption appears to the right of the picture.
